name: Alchemy England

prices.note: Alchemy Apparel - T-Shirts: 9 regular-price short-sleeve tees served (collection lists 22), all $40, horror-themed graphics (e.g. 'The Mummy', 'Curse of Frankenstein'); none on sale. Regular price = no variant with compare_at_price above price and no sale/markdown/clearance tag; long-sleeve, tank, polo, hoodie, bundle and mystery items excluded so the range is short-sleeve tees.

notes: alchemygothic.com ('Alchemy Gothic Official Site', The Alchemy Carta Limited) is a museum/catalogue site that sends shoppers to the Alchemy England store; alchemyengland.com (UK) says US customers should order at alchemyofengland.com, the US store used here (USD, Fort Worth TX warehouse).

About: established 1977 by Geoff Kayson and Trevor Phillipson; 'Our factory and HQ is located in Leicestershire, England'. UK site: 'UK-based makers of high quality Jewellery and Giftware'. Jewellery is the main line (pendants, earrings, rings); tees are a small apparel range.

Shipping: 'All USA and Canadian customers are serviced from our US warehouse'; Free Standard Shipping on orders of $100 or more; other countries served from the UK site. Returns page gives no window for undamaged items (credit to account) and 15 days to report damage, so returns_days is null.
Page texts (About, policies) were read from the store's public /pages.json as well as by WebFetch.
